text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after returning to the turf training 
course, Satono Diamond's running remained 
off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from it, she was completely out of 
sorts. Her lap times just kept dropping.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“Will the adjustments be ready in time for 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...?”
choice_data_list:
If we start finishing it now, I think 
we'll just barely make it in time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We didn't need 100% form for our prep 
race in the Kyoto Daishoten, but even so, 
there's no time left before the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I'll reset my running form for now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I cannot possibly run like this in a race 
against McQueen-san...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I'll make sure we're ready in time 
for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

Yeah. I'll make sure you're ready in time 
for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It must have been a bitter decision for 
her. To honor her feelings, I have to make 
sure she enters the Tenno Sho (Autumn) in 
peak condition!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Her pitch should've been faster before... 
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kgh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, she was unable to recapture the way 
she used to run."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By focusing too much on reverting to her 
previous form, she conversely ended up 
throwing off her balance more and more. 
And as panic set in, she became even more 
overly conscious of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How can we break this vicious cycle? —If 
Satono Diamond has forgotten how she 
runs...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~. Trainer, what was it you 
wanted to consult me about?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I think I get the gist. There really 
is something off about Dia-chan's running 
lately, isn't there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond tries to return to her 
original running style, but gives a brief 
explanation that it isn't going well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... In that case, would you 
like to run with me?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how to solve it, but I feel 
like everything will work out if we just 
run for now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Are you going to run with Kita-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right! At 2200m, just like the Takarazuka 
Kinen. I want to go over what happened 
back then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. The distance is right between 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn) and the Kyoto 
Daishoten. It seems well-suited for me 
too."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Dia-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Jeez... I'm the one who should be saying 
thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 2,200-meter run with Kitasan 
Black began.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(So I don't get left behind here, I'll 
pick up the pace just a little...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Teyaaa...! Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, I'm not moving forward! Am I 
overstriding? ...No, they're pulling 
further and further ahead...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...I can't run properly...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Dia-chan seems to be feeling under 
the weather.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Don't overdo it, let's call it a day!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No, I'm not ready yet...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, I felt like Dia-chan wasn't really 
able to focus on running together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If you're not focused, you might end up 
getting hurt. How about we wrap it up for 
today?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's call it a day. Get plenty of 
rest.

Yeah, let's call it a day. Get plenty of 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Understood. Thank you for your hard 
work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps convinced by the fear of injury, 
Satono Diamond nodded obediently.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's still early. Let's take a detour 
on our way back!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan... I'm sorry. I—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Wah! ...Kita-chan, I...!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm starving! Shopping street first, let's 
go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What flavor was Dia-chan's again?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's half chili cheese dog and half mint 
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-You picked an unusual combination again, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I thought the unexpected twist would make 
it fun. It's spicy, refreshing, and full 
of kick♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You're quite the challenger.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm thirsty, let's go buy some drinks! 
Then we can drink them somewhere with a 
nice view!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan! My hand... If you pull me 
suddenly, I'm going to drop my taiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry! But hey, I didn't drop it, 
did I?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...Back when we were little, Kita-chan 
used to pull me along by the hand just 
like this...)

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan... where are you going...?

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Just a little more. Look...—

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Whoaa...! It's so high...!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
"This is my special secret spot! I wanted 
to share it with you, Dia-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(You took me to so many different 
places...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Climbing all that in one 
go really takes it out of you...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah... *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Back then too, you took me by the hand and 
brought me here... right, Kita-chan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not just here, but to so many places. 
Kita-chan showed me the outside world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...I've always thought of Kita-chan as an 
older sister."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I was thinking I should act like a 
big sister whenever I'm with Dia-chan, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I always thought I should be the one 
walking in front of Dia-chan, leading the 
way for her...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Dia-chan! Let's race to the 
riverbank!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a race? What brought this on all of a 
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's do it! Ready, 
steady... GO!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wait... That's not fair, Kita-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, looks like I win! Alright, next 
is... all the way to the park!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Geez...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Come on, I'm gonna leave you behind!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Dia-chan! Hurry up! We're gonna 
leave you behind!

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Wait up! Kita-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Eheh, just a little more...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa... I won't get left behind!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the last stretch is all the way 
to the dorms! The goal is when we reach 
the dorms!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I'll catch up next time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...A long time ago, I ran just like this, 
staring only at that back...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I just wanted to catch up to 
Kita-chan...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...All right!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...Huh? I'm... running...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Without thinking about anything, I can 
just... naturally... run...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...I see. Chasing after Kita-chan, I was 
always just running with all my heart...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I wondered what kind of face Kita-chan 
would make if I caught up to her back and 
passed her...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I'm having so much fun. ...Running is so 
much fun!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Goooal!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ......Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What is it, Dia-chan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, that was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah!! Me too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll overtake you next time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...! Heheh, just try it if you can!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I'll run to my heart's content. Just like 
back then...)
